imageHint: A fixed version only. A move to another major version is confirmed, and backed up first.
invalidImage: Enter an image such as name:tag.

commandHint.default: Runs with /bin/sh -c instead of the image's own start command. Leave empty to use the image's.
commandHint.redis: Runs with /bin/sh -c instead of the default command. Keep the password in it, for example: redis-server --requirepass "$REDIS_PASSWORD" --maxmemory 256mb

envHint: One NAME=value per line, added to the engine's own variables.
invalidEnv: Each line must look like NAME=value.
configFileHint: Kept beside the server's own configuration. Takes effect at the next deployment.
deployNote: Saving only stores these settings. Redeploying is what applies them, and it restarts the database.
savedHint: Redeploy the database to apply them.
fixedImage: Name a fixed version, such as postgres:18.6, or pin a digest.

majorChange.title: Move to another major version?
majorChange.description: {{from}} becomes {{to}} at the next deployment, which may need the data to be migrated. That deployment takes a backup of the whole server first and stops if the backup fails. If the new version does not start, the previous one comes back.
majorChange.descriptionRedis: {{from}} becomes {{to}} at the next deployment. Redis has no backups in the panel, so its data stays only on its volume. If the new version does not start, the previous one comes back.
